And the concession that costs most: everything above is one instrument, one window and one unit, and the reason the unit was never re-measured is that re-measuring it needs more data than sixty closes can give. That is the shape of eighty-five pages in one sentence. Every one of them has been an arithmetic you can reproduce on a record small enough to hold, and a record that small can carry a method and cannot carry a market. It also means that everything measured so far has been the market, and nothing at all has been you. Module 12 turns the same instrument round. It takes lesson 63’s seven trades, holds every entry and exit signal exactly where they are, and prices four things a trader does to them — and lesson 86 finds that the first of the four leaves the win rate at six of seven at every setting it tries, while the money runs from 7.64 a share to 11.74.
